app.name: Enhanced Views & Backlog Manager
app.short_description: Ticket description filtering, calendar date ranges, and duplicate customer ticket detector.
app.long_description: Overcomes native Zendesk Views limitations: (1) Filter tickets by keywords in descriptions/bodies, (2) Filter tickets by real calendar dates rather than hours, and (3) Identify customers with multiple open tickets to quickly review and merge duplicates.
app.installation_instructions: Upload the zip file in Zendesk Admin Center > Apps and integrations > Apps > Zendesk Support apps > Upload private app.
